variants.text: We approved the migration to PostgreSQL.
The migration to PostgreSQL was approved.
Pay invoice INV-14 for $2,000.
Invoice INV-14 will be paid in the amount of $2,000.
Enable dark mode for the dashboard.
Dark mode will be enabled for the dashboard.
Set customer CUST-91 discount to 24% through August 2025.
Apply a 24% discount to CUST-91 through August 2025.
Buy domain DOM-3779.example for campaign CMP-3779.
Campaign CMP-3779 will acquire domain DOM-3779.example.
Schedule maintenance WIN-760 on host HST-760 at 16:00 UTC.
Maintenance window WIN-760 for HST-760 starts at 16:00 UTC.
Host HST-760 maintenance WIN-760 is booked for 16:00 UTC.
Allow employees three remote days per week.
Employees may work remotely three days each week.
Archive channel CH-10 to vault VT-10.
Channel CH-10 will be archived in vault VT-10.
Hire two backend engineers this quarter.
Recruit 2 backend developers this quarter.
Block public access to S3 buckets.
Public S3 buckets must be blocked.
Turn on fraud alerts for transactions above $5,000.
Enable transaction fraud notifications over five thousand dollars.
Fraud alerts will be enabled for transactions over $5,000.
Keep audit logs for 90 days.
Audit logs will be retained for ninety days.
Raise subscription prices by 10% next quarter.
A ten percent subscription price increase starts next quarter.
Increase subscription pricing ten percent next quarter.
Grant role ROLE-8 to service account SA-8.
Service account SA-8 is assigned ROLE-8.
ROLE-8 will be granted to service account SA-8.
Cancel the Acme vendor contract.
The Acme vendor contract will be cancelled.
Reject RFC-41 about feature FEAT-41.
RFC-41 for FEAT-41 has been rejected.
Cap wallet WAL-4026 spend at $52/day.
Set a daily $52 spending limit for wallet WAL-4026.
Close the Dhaka office on May 1.
The Dhaka location will shut down May 1.
The Dhaka office will be closed on May 1.
Deploy service checkout-api to staging on Tuesday.
The checkout-api staging deployment is scheduled for Tuesday.
Checkout-api will go to staging Tuesday.
Approve a hiring freeze for the design team.
The design team hiring freeze was approved.
